Food

What comes to the table

From what guests write in their Google reviews.

Moussaka

30 reviews mention the moussaka, baked in a clay dish. Guests also recommend the vegetarian moussaka.

From the charcoal grill

Pork and chicken souvlaki, sheftalia and lamb chops. One guest writes that no one grills chicken on charcoal as well as they do.

Meze and dips

13 reviews mention the meze, 8 the tzatziki. Guests recommend the dip platter for two.

Platters for two

Mixed grill and meze for two people. Guests describe the portions as big and generous.

Φύσα & Μάσα, on the charcoal

A small tavern at Ledras 55, in the middle of the pedestrian street of old Nicosia. Cypriot cooking from the charcoal grill, tables inside and outside, and live music with singers at the tables, as guests write. Open from 10:00, closed on Mondays.

What guests say

Three of 464 Google reviews, 429 of them with five stars.

“Some of the most delicious food we’ve had in Cyprus, accompanied with fantastic live music. The singer was incredible. Beautiful out door seating and great service. Would highly recommend.”

Google review
“Very tasty authentic food. Prices are very fair, portions are big and fulfilling. Especially recommend the dip platter for two and vegetarian moussaka. Can get quite busy so tables aren’t always available.”

Google review
“Really good local restaurant with all the expected options and some extra interesting dishes. I had pork souvlaki and it was great but there are a lot more options if this is not your vibe. The staff is really nice and pretty fast to serve you. Prices are really reasonable as well”
